description.language: Choose the language hint for new Live Realtime sessions.
description.task: Choose whether Live Realtime transcribes source audio or translates it to English.
description.minChunkMs: Control the minimum audio window sent to the realtime transcriber.
description.bufferTrimmingMs: Control how much recent audio context remains in the streaming buffer.
description.promptMaxChars: Limit the text context carried forward between realtime decoding passes.
description.timestampToleranceMs: Allow small timestamp shifts when merging realtime segments.
description.maxDuplicateNgram: Suppress repeated text when the same phrase appears across adjacent chunks.
description.silenceRmsThreshold: Set the audio RMS level treated as silence by the realtime segmenter.
description.segmentCloseSilenceMs: Close the current segment after this amount of detected silence.
description.contextResetSilenceMs: Reset rolling text context after a longer silence gap.
description.beamSize: Set the beam-search width for each realtime decode pass.
description.bestOf: Set the number of candidates considered during sampling-based decoding.
description.temperature: Set one or more decoding temperatures used as fallback attempts.
description.compressionRatioThreshold: Reject likely repetitive output above this compression ratio.
description.logProbThreshold: Reject low-confidence output below this average log probability.
description.noSpeechThreshold: Tune the model no-speech gate before accepting decoded text.
description.conditionOnPreviousText: Let each decode pass condition on previous realtime text context.
description.vadFilter: Enable Faster-Whisper voice activity filtering before decoding.
description.vadThreshold: Tune the probability threshold used to detect speech.
description.vadMinSilenceDurationMs: Set the silence duration required to split speech regions.
description.vadSpeechPadMs: Add audio padding before and after detected speech regions.
description.vadNegThreshold: Tune the lower threshold used when leaving speech state.
description.vadMinSpeechDurationMs: Ignore detected speech regions shorter than this duration.
description.vadMaxSpeechDurationS: Split speech regions that exceed this duration.

numberList.invalidNumber: Each value must be a valid number
